sourceFile: 24. MSU-L20S15-07GMI  Report Test film 85A improve NG function SPK and module - 2025.06.23_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: The 85A vs 70A comparison is valid, but outcome pairing and grouping errors block final use.
issues: Function result mispairs June 28 test with June 24 normal instead of same-date normal row.
Summary outcome is overbroad and judges only Sub1-forming while other domains differ.
June and July sheets are separate rounds and need explicit date/round subgrouping.
Tension statistics undercount samples and omit the stated 1.2 kgf spec.
Test!40 is cited but its row text is not provided for verification.
correctionPlan: Set changed factor to Film 85A test versus Normal Film 70A baseline.
Repair function comparisons, including Test!45 versus Test!47 for the June 28 round.
Split or relabel Sum outcomes by domain and mark overall summary as mixed if retained.
Add date/sheet/test-round subgroup keys to all subresults.
Recompute tension sample counts and include the 1.2 kgf pass criterion.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Most citations exist, but final evidence is insufficient until mispaired and uncited rows are corrected.
